images.filename: These four Coast Guard invaders served aboard one of 12 Coast Guard-manned LSTs (Landing Ship Tanks) which hit the beach and helped smash bitter Jap resistance on the beach of Wakde Island off Sarmi (51276607034).jpg
images.caption:
Their LST shows in the left background as it pours out heavy fighting equipment. The four Coast Guardsmen, one of whom holds a long Jap knife, are left to right: B.W. Long, coxswain, of Detroit, Mich.; G.W. Greenleaf, chief boatswain's mate, of Boothbay, Me.; J.L. Rainier, signalman first class, of Philadelphia, PA.; and E.P. Vaughn, machinist's mate first class, of San Antonio, Texas.
U.S. Coast Guard Public Relations Photo.
026-g-078-006-001

Photographer not given.
